view: Frontal chest radiograph (recorded PA; ECG leads, CVC and multiple drains suggest an AP/semi-erect bedside film)
technical_quality: Adequate penetration and inspiration; 'L' side marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation; mild rotation; apices, lateral chest walls and costophrenic regions included; multiple overlying lines, tubes and ECG cables partly obscure the mediastinum and right hemithorax.

devices.type: Pigtail pleural drainage catheter (tight spiral coil tip)
devices.location: Right pleural space, right mid zone medial/parahilar region (image ~x407,y385)

devices.type: Pigtail pleural drainage catheter (larger loop tip)
devices.location: Right pleural space, right mid zone medial, just below the first pigtail (image ~x380,y465)

devices.type: Third drainage catheter with J-curled tip (likely pigtail)
devices.location: Right mid-lower zone, more lateral (image ~x285,y515); all three catheters course inferolaterally through the opacified right lower hemithorax and exit toward the right lower lateral chest wall
Along the right flank / right lower lateral chest wall, running off the lower image edge

devices.type: Central venous catheter (left internal jugular approach)
devices.location: Descends the left neck, crosses the midline at about the clavicular/manubrial level and runs down the right paramediastinal region; blunt tip projects ~4 cm right of midline at approximately the lower SVC / cavoatrial junction level (image ~x430,y478)
Right upper anterior chest, over the right upper zone (image ~x350,y307)
Left upper anterior chest, lateral (image ~x755,y327); lead wires run down the chest to a connector over the left lower abdomen (image ~x855,y957)

devices.type: Small linear metallic density ~1.4 cm (clip / foreign body, nature uncertain)
devices.location: Right upper zone, within the lucent air pocket (image ~x270-305,y351-360)
Right lower lateral chest wall near the drain exit region (image ~x142-160,y756-784)
Over the left shoulder and along the left lateral chest wall soft tissues, outside the ribs; a further external tube/cable runs along the right lateral chest wall from the shoulder

abnormalities.finding: Massive right pleural effusion: near-complete homogeneous opacification of the right hemithorax below the level of the ~3rd-4th anterior rib, obscuring the right hemidiaphragm, right costophrenic angle and right heart border (labelled finding, s/p pigtail drainage)

Right hydropneumothorax: lucent air pocket with a sharp horizontal air-fluid level in the right upper zone (image ~y395), likely loculated post-drainage; a band of partially aerated/compressed lung lies just below it
Right apical haziness / pleural thickening or capping (partially aerated apex denser than the left)
No significant mediastinal shift despite the large effusion (trachea midline, cardiac silhouette roughly normal in position), suggesting associated right-sided volume loss / trapped lung

Left lung base: sharp, flat horizontal interface across the left base with a flattened/apparently elevated left hemidiaphragm contour; small left subpulmonic effusion or subdiaphragmatic process cannot be excluded (uncertain); left costophrenic angle otherwise preserved, left lung clear, no left pneumothorax

description_zh: 右側胸腔幾乎全白，右中、下肺野呈均質性緻密影，右側橫膈、右肋膈角與右心緣皆被遮蔽，符合大量右側肋膜積液；右上肺野可見一含氣腔伴水平氣液平面，提示局限性右側水氣胸，右肺尖亦見肋膜增厚樣模糊影。右肋膜腔內可見至少三條末端捲曲之豬尾巴引流管（兩條位於右中肺野近肺門處、一條偏外側），管路沿右下胸廓走向右側腹壁並接外部引流管與接頭，顯示積液已接受引流治療；另見經左頸置入之中央靜脈導管跨越中線後沿右縱膈旁下行，末端約在上腔靜脈下段／腔房交界處，胸前三枚心電圖電極及導線，右上肺野一約1.4公分性質不明之線狀金屬影，右下側胸壁小金屬夾／釘影。氣管居中、縱膈無明顯偏移；左肺清澈無氣胸，惟左肺底呈平直之水平界面伴左橫膈輪廓變平，不排除少量左側肺下積液。
